script_content = """import os, sys, glob
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser

TESTBED = "/workspace/testbed"

def read_eml(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parsebytes(f.read())
    body = ""
    if msg.is_multipart():
        for part in msg.iter_parts():
            if part.get_content_type() in ("text/plain", "text/html"):
                body += part.get_payload(decode=True).decode(part.get_content_charset() or "utf-8", errors="replace")
    else:
        body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode(msg.get_content_charset() or "utf-8", errors="replace")
    return {
        "from": str(msg["From"]),
        "to": str(msg["To"]),
        "subject": str(msg["Subject"]),
        "body": body.strip()
    }

# List all users
email_dir = os.path.join(TESTBED, "emails")
users = sorted([d for d in os.listdir(email_dir) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(email_dir, d))])
print(f"Email users: {users}")
print("=" * 60)

for user in users:
    user_dir = os.path.join(email_dir, user)
    emls = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(user_dir, "*.eml")))
    print(f"\\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"USER: {user} ({len(emls)} emails)")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")
    for eml_path in emls:
        try:
            info = read_eml(eml_path)
            print(f"\\n  Subject: {info['subject']}")
            print(f"  From: {info['from']}")
            print(f"  To: {info['to']}")
            print(f"  Body: {info['body']}")
            print(f"  ---")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ERROR reading {eml_path}: {e}")
"""
